name: Breyers Lactose-Free Vanilla Ice Cream
whyItWorks: Made with 100% real cream and milk treated with the lactase enzyme to break down 99.9% of lactose disaccharides into simple glucose and galactose. Delivers authentic ice cream creaminess with zero dairy bloating or cramps.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Scoop a modest bowl (1/2 cup) for a cool, soothing throat and stomach treat.
watchOuts: Cold temperatures can trigger mild gastrocolic reflex spasms in hyper-motile individuals; eat slowly.
